verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents agent-initiated stablecoin payments over named rails. The x402 guide has agents sign USDC payments on Base and read back an onchain settlement receipt via getPaymentSettleResponse. MPP endpoints are paid via Tempo, and a quickstart sends USDXM through a user-owned wallet with an onchain-enforced delegated agent signer; offramp APIs then cash stablecoins out to fiat. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these settlement flows work as documented.
